stem: Ananya wants to observe the constellation Orion from the balcony of her flat in Jaipur. Which statement about whether she can see it is not correct?

options.text: She can see Orion only if the sky is clear and free of clouds.
Bright streetlights near her home can make Orion harder to see.
Orion can be seen tonight from every place on Earth because it is in the sky.
She should choose a place where buildings do not block her view of the sky.

teacher.key_rationale: Night-sky visibility depends on a clear dark sky, low light pollution, an open viewing area, and the observer's place, date and time; an object in the sky cannot be seen from every place on Earth at will, so statement C is the one that is not correct.
